newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London end mixed in weak trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London end mixed in weak trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London ended mixed on Thursday, with a slightly weaker bias, hinged on profit-taking in several high-tech stocks, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese shares in London was up 1.66 points or 0.11 percent at 1,455.61 by 1450 GMT, after the Nikkei 225 in Tokyo was down 46.62 points or 0.22 percent.
"The market is fairly mixed and weaker. We have some profit taking in issues such as Hitachi, Toshiba and Sony and some buying interest in NEC," said one dealer.
Dealers said the market was awaiting results of several Japanese banks on Friday.
"We expect some profit taking in the market tommorrow as it will be the end of the week," said the dealer.
